set.body:
Scope: image-view, Canvas/Java2D/JavaFX hosts, associated examples/assets and conformance tests.

Deliverable: Extract neuroimaging slice placement, orientation labels, crosshairs and interaction policy to optional neuroim4s view modules. Reuse Intaglio graphics/backend capabilities.

Acceptance:
- Pure viewer behavior passes on JVM/JS; applicable Canvas/Java2D/JavaFX render, pick, orientation and cursor checks retain actual platform evidence.
- Volume core/IO/transforms resolve without display or GUI dependencies; linked surface views are a separate integration.
- Examples and assets move with behavior; no duplicate raster/color/scene kernel is introduced when Intaglio already owns it.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: I1: Move optional volume slice scenes and platform hosts
